scene: The ribbon seller proudly displays spools of fluttering, enchanted streamers.
picture: Flat side-view along sunny grass. On the left stands a canopy cart draped in colorful banners. The boy in his orange vest and white scarf stands centre, browsing the counter. A copper spool sits on the left counter, a badger sleeps under the cart, and on the far right stands a tall mooring ladder.
shown: A shimmering metallic copper spool resting on the left counter edge
A plump striped badger curled asleep beneath the cart on the right
A tall wooden mooring ladder standing upright on the far right

variants.scene: Colorful ribbons flutter softly as the friendly merchant welcomes you to his cart.
The breeze carries sunset warmth and rustling silk across the meadow.
Bright streamers wave in the wind while you still keep searching for {quest}.
